recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add another redundant link on the Value Sets page unless the downloads packaging changes; the current nearby note and Downloads page entries already convey the requested path.
issue_request: FHIR-13797 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core STU3 issue asking for the Value Sets Defined in FHIR page to link to downloadable FHIR ValueSet definitions in XML/JSON format.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 12696, imported as git commit 6433f4a58f05de1dc52d387f45e21b6d52ae951e. That commit added a note to source/terminologies-valuesets.html pointing readers to downloads.html for the FHIR definitions, and also added an expansions download row to source/downloads.html.
additional_context: The current source/terminologies-valuesets.html still has the download pointer. The current source/downloads.html has a "FHIR Definitions" row with XML and JSON links to definitions.xml.zip and definitions.json.zip, described as containing all value sets, profiles, etc. defined as part of the FHIR specification and included implementation guides. source/hierarchy.xml includes both terminologies-valuesets.html and downloads.html in the current page hierarchy, so these source pages are in build scope. Later FHIR-25896 wording changes clarified the value-set page scope but preserved the FHIR-13797 download pointer.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already provides the requested implementer path: the Value Sets page links to downloads.html, and downloads.html exposes XML and JSON definitions packages that include ValueSet definitions.

related_jiras.note: Later terminology-page clarification preserved the Value Sets page download pointer while clarifying where non-core value sets can be found.
